user.title: Swiss Electricity Price (ElCom)
user.description: Search for your grid operator by name (e.g. part of the company or municipality name) and press submit — {count} shown below. To refine, change the search text and submit again. Operators marked "direct link" have a machine-readable tariff file that was just verified reachable; operators marked "auto-detect" either only report a general web page, or their reported file could not be verified, and their tariff data may not be found automatically. If your operator's link still doesn't work, select the operator and paste the actual tariff file URL under "Manual tariff file URL" (find it on the operator's own website — it's a JSON file, look for "tarif"/"tariff" in the page or its links). If neither works, you'll be offered to enter your rates by hand on the next screen — no need to fill in a URL if you don't have one.

location.title: {operator}
location.description: Choose your municipality, and your energy and grid tariff product, exactly as published by {operator}. Pick both separately (rather than one combined "tariff") since operators do not always name or categorize their energy and grid products the same way. Leave "Grid tariff already includes the federal levies" ticked if the operator's grid price already contains the federal grid surcharge (Art. 35 EnG), system services, electricity reserve and solidarity surcharge — this is what the official tariff format prescribes and what e.g. BKW publishes. Some operators publish the grid price without them and list the levies separately on the bill: untick it then, and 3.03 Rp/kWh are added. Compare the resulting price with one bill; the amount stays adjustable afterwards.

data.grid_includes_levies: Grid tariff already includes the federal levies

cantonal.title: {operator}: cantonal levies
cantonal.description: The tariff file of {operator} lists {count} entries under cantonal levies. Tick the ones that appear on your bill — they are then added to the combined price — and, among those, the ones your bill shows without VAT (a cantonal tax such as Vaud's 0.6 Rp/kWh is billed without VAT; a cantonal fee with it). Nothing is preselected: operators put different things under this heading, some even the federal levies, which the previous step already covers — ticking those as well would count them twice. Both choices can be changed later in the Configure dialog; every entry also gets its own sensor.

manual.title: {operator}
manual.description: No usable tariff file could be found for {operator} — neither the registered link nor a URL you supplied worked (or it worked but had no usable data). Enter your known rates by hand instead; find them on your electricity bill or the operator's rate sheet.

data.manual_low_rp: Low-tariff price (Rp/kWh, optional — leave empty for a flat rate)

abort.already_configured: This grid operator is already configured with the same municipality and tariff products (or already has a manual entry).
abort.cannot_connect: The ElCom operator directory could not be retrieved.
abort.no_data: The ElCom operator directory contains no operators for the current year.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.

error.no_matches: No operator matches that search. Change the search text above and submit again.
error.manual_url_needs_operator: A manual URL was entered but no operator was selected. Please also select the operator this URL belongs to.
error.invalid_time: Please enter times in HH:MM format (e.g. 06:00).

init.title: Electricity Price Settings

data.vat_exempt_levies_rp: Levies exempt from VAT (Rp/kWh, added after VAT)

init.description: National levies, VAT rate and the amount exempt from VAT apply to the combined price sensors. For an entry based on the tariff file of {operator}, the municipality and the energy and grid tariff product can be re-selected here from the file as it is today: operators rename products or restructure their file from one year to the next, and the combined price sensors stay unavailable until the current names are chosen. If the file lists cantonal levies, tick the ones on your bill and, among those, the ones billed without VAT. Changing any of these reloads the entry; entity ids and history are kept.

error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this municipality and these tariff products.

manual_link_available.title: A working tariff file was found for {operator}
manual_link_available.description: This entry was set up with manually entered rates because no usable tariff file could be found for {operator} at the time. A working machine-readable tariff file is now available. To switch from manual entry to full automatic tariffs (with municipality and metering-fee sensors), remove this integration entry and set it up again — the operator's link should now resolve on the first try.

selection_missing.title: {operator}: chosen tariff product or municipality no longer in the tariff file
selection_missing.description: The tariff file of {operator} no longer contains: {missing}. The operator renamed or removed it, so the combined price sensors, the tariff level and the high-tariff sensor of this entry are unavailable. Open the entry's Configure dialog and choose the current names from the list; the entry reloads and keeps its entity ids and history.

get_price.name: Get price
get_price.description: Returns the electricity price in force at a moment (now by default) with its tariff level, how long it stays, and the price that follows.

config_entry.name: Tariff
config_entry.description: The Swiss Electricity Price entry (operator and tariff selection) to evaluate.

datetime.name: Time
datetime.description: The moment to evaluate; leave empty for now.

get_price_schedule.name: Get price schedule
get_price_schedule.description: Returns the hourly price curve of a period (from the current hour to the end of tomorrow by default), its minimum, maximum and average, and optionally the cheapest hours.

config_entry.name: Tariff
config_entry.description: The Swiss Electricity Price entry (operator and tariff selection) to evaluate.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period; leave empty for the current hour.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period; leave empty for the end of tomorrow. At most 14 days.

cheapest_hours.name: Cheapest hours
cheapest_hours.description: Also return the N cheapest hours of the period, cheapest first.

entry_not_found.message: The tariff entry does not exist.

entry_not_loaded.message: The tariff entry "{title}" is not loaded.

no_price.message: "{title}" has no usable tariff selection at the moment (products or municipality missing from the tariff file).

end_before_start.message: The end has to be after the start.

period_too_long.message: The period may span at most 14 days.
